claude.sample_unit: EHR records (ARMD dataset; a second BV-BRC/PATRIC genomic dataset had 400,372 records)
models_evaluated: Random Forest (500 estimators) with SISA (5 shards)

links.outcome: Speed and accuracy cost of removing individual patient data from deployed AMR models (SISA vs. full retraining)
links.effect: SISA gave 8.9× speedup on ARMD (7.5 s vs 66.7 s) and 9.8× on PATRIC (1.4 s vs 13.4 s), with accuracy costs of 0.024% and 0.048%, below the 0.5% threshold.
links.quote: SISA achieved an 8.9× speedup over full retraining on ARMD (7.5 s vs. 66.7 s) and a 9.8 × speedup on PATRIC (1.4 s vs. 13.4 s), with accuracy costs of 0.024% and 0.048%, respectively, both below the 0.5% clinical threshold.
